channel.name: The History Guy
channel.tagline: Strange but true history in 40 seconds

audience.writing_note: AUDIENCE: viewers in the United States and Europe. Use American English spelling. Add one short clause of context for anything a non-local viewer may not know (where it is, who they were). Avoid slang and idioms that do not travel. Quote units exactly as the evidence does; never convert. Neutral, factual tone; no jokes at any nation's expense.
